title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Clear answers about intellectual property, payment terms, warranties, and our engineering process.

items.question: Who owns the code once the software is delivered?
items.answer: 100% yours from day one. We transfer full repository ownership and credentials with zero vendor lock-in or recurring software licensing fees.

items.question: How do you ensure compliance with data protection regulations?
items.answer: We enforce privacy-by-design: role-based access control, cryptographic data protection at rest and in transit, and compliance with GDPR and Colombian Law 1581.

items.question: Can your builds integrate with payment gateways and ERP systems?
items.answer: Yes. We connect custom software to payment processors (Stripe, Wompi, PayU), ERPs (SAP, Siigo, Alegra), and messaging APIs like WhatsApp Cloud.

items.question: What kind of support and warranty do you offer after launch?
items.answer: Every project includes a 90-day technical stability warranty covering bug fixes at no extra charge, alongside optional ongoing SLA maintenance.

items.question: How do you handle communication and milestones during development?
items.answer: We ship functional increments every week to a staging environment where you test features directly and communicate straight with the engineering team.
